issues: 全景是灰白占位 dashboard，目标卡只有一个大写 IMPACT，看不出这一拳打在什么事情上
撞停后的特写是一张空白占位卡，持续近 3 秒只有一个单词可读，画面没有信息也没有设计
灰底 + 靛蓝描边，负片帧之外整条镜头没有色彩与层次
撞停后的恢复段只有震屏，没有给"命中"一个落定的视觉标点
changes: look 换成 paper（暖白纸 · 墨 · 朱红），但走漫画分格：整幅是 5 格分镜页，7px 墨线格框 + 网点，讲一条虚构部署工具 Shiden 的流水线（Push → Tests 214/214 → Build 3.1 s → Deploy → 品牌格）
手法落到内容上：主格起初是 DEPLOYING + 92% 进度条，急推撞停同一帧翻成 140px 斜体 DEPLOYED.——负片打击帧就是部署成功的那一拳
打击帧保留 3f 负片 + 34 粗楔 22 细针集中线（每帧换形态）+ 红青 ±9px 错位；急推到 1.74x 让主格高≈画高 93%，带时间采样运动模糊与中心锐利遮罩
恢复帧加一枚朱红描墨的拟声字「ドン!」弹簧盖章砸上格角，进度条变朱红满格、14 regions · 0.8 s 随后升起
节奏：0–24 整页正视建立（进度条在走、6–20 朱红锁定框亮起）→ 6f 预备回拉 → 6f 急推 → 3f 打击 → 震屏衰减 → 2s+ 读格 hold（相机再推 2%），总长 135f
issuesEn: The wide shot was a grey placeholder dashboard and the target card only said IMPACT, so the punch landed on nothing in particular
After the hit the close-up was a blank placeholder card holding for almost 3 seconds with a single readable word
Grey background with an indigo outline: outside the negative frames the shot had no colour or depth
The recovery only had a screen shake; the hit never got a visual full stop
changesEn: Paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion) done as a manga page: five panels with 7px ink borders and screentone telling a fictional deploy tool's pipeline (Push, Tests 214/214, Build 3.1 s, Deploy, brand panel)
The technique carries meaning: the hero panel reads DEPLOYING with a 92% bar and flips to a 140px italic DEPLOYED. on the exact stop frame, so the negative impact frame is the moment the deploy lands

The 3f negative, 34 thick wedges plus 22 needles of focus lines (new shape every frame) and ±9px red/cyan split are kept; the crash zoom to 1.74x makes the panel ~93% of frame height, with sub-frame motion blur and a sharp centre mask
On recovery a vermilion, ink-outlined ドン! sound effect stamps onto the panel corner on a spring, the bar fills vermilion and 14 regions · 0.8 s rises in
Rhythm: 0–24 frontal page establish (bar creeping, vermilion lock frame at 6–20), 6f wind-back, 6f crash zoom, 3f impact, decaying shake, then a 2s+ reading hold with a 2% push; 135f total
